hero.outcome: Turn device data into autonomous operations.
hero.description: Agents that turn device telemetry into autonomous, supervised operations for industrial fleets.

problem.title: Reacting after the fact
problem.description: Device fleets generate constant telemetry, but operators can't watch everything. Issues are often found only after a failure, and manual triage doesn't scale with fleet size.

outcome.title: Operate by exception
outcome.description: Prime Agentic turns telemetry into supervised actions, flagging anomalies and proposing next steps so operators act before small issues become failures.

features.title: Telemetry ingestion
features.description: Agents collect and normalize signals from a fleet of devices.

features.title: Anomaly detection
features.description: Agents flag readings that deviate from expected behavior.

features.title: Supervised actions
features.description: Agents propose next steps that an operator approves before they run.

features.title: Fleet dashboards
features.description: A single view of device health and open actions across the fleet.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Agents map the fleet and the operational rules for each device type.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: Agents monitor telemetry and propose actions when something is off.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.description: As operators approve or override, agents learn and refine their proposals.

useCases.title: Industrial fleets
useCases.description: Monitor machines at scale and catch issues before they stop production.

useCases.title: Building management
useCases.description: Turn sensor data into coordinated maintenance and efficiency actions.

useCases.title: Utilities and energy
useCases.description: Supervise distributed assets and prioritize the exceptions that matter.

faqs.question: When will this be available?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] The platform is in development; availability timing will be announced.

faqs.question: Is there an early access program?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Early access details are still being defined.

faqs.question: What does this demo show?
faqs.answer: The demo is an illustrative walkthrough of the coordination approach, using a fictional fleet and mock telemetry.

faqs.question: Does it act fully autonomously?
faqs.answer: No. Agents propose actions, but consequential actions are approved by a human operator before they run.
